video_title: Klay Thompson Talks Joining Miami Heat, His Redemption Season, Living By Bahamas, Chris Quinn's Boat

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on his decision to join the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: Miami was always on my mind. My agent and I approached Dallas with the buyout because things change.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: Can you take us a little into the whole situation? Was it a stressful thing in the summer? Was it a process of teams or was it always Miami on your mind?

text_blocks.speaker: Klay Thompson
text_blocks.text: Miami was always on my mind. My agent and I approached Dallas with the buyout because things change a lot when I signed there in 2024. They were great in honoring our request and understanding that those things did happen and that I'm on the back end of things. They understood I wanted a chance to really make a deep postseason run. I'm not saying they won't do that, but I think just Miami was way better position for that. It wasn't too stressful though. I knew I always had a chance to end up here and I'm just happy it all worked out.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on his connection to his Bahamian family
quotes.excerpt: I've never been this close in proximity to my Bahamian family. To be this close is super special.
quotes.quote: I've never been this close in proximity to my Bahamian family. I grew up on the West Coast, I went to college there, I played professionally there, so to be this close to them is super special. I get a chance to play in front of them on a consistent basis. It feels like a second home. In Dallas at times it felt like I was kind of out there by myself a lot, but now it feels like I'm right at home. The Bahamas is right across the water and my family will be here all the time. It gives me new life to make them proud and wear that Thompson on the back of my jersey with great pride.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on his motivation for a redemption season
quotes.excerpt: I just missed out on the postseason and I hate watching from home. You just get FOMO.
quotes.quote: I thought I didn't play up to my standards last season. I thought in 2025 I played decent, but I just missed out on the postseason and I hate watching from home. You just get FOMO watching all your coworkers or your peers just getting to chase their dreams and it's not fun not making the playoffs. That's all I want to have to do these next couple years, have a chance to make a deep postseason run. It's so exciting to be in Miami. They are a very demanding organization, but I love being in that ultra-competitive atmosphere and this was just a match made in heaven.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on the common threads of winning organizations
quotes.excerpt: All the individual accolades, all the notoriety you get from playing this game doesn't hit the same.
quotes.quote: I would say the practices and everyone being on the same page as far as training staff, front office, coaching staff, and the players. Obviously you have to have a healthy ego as an NBA player, but when everyone lets their guard down and understands that winning is the best thing in the world, all the individual accolades, all the notoriety you get from playing this game doesn't hit the same as chasing a championship. I know Pat and Spo know all about that, so does Bam, so does Giannis, so does Wiggins. These young guys are all hungry to make their mark in this league and that fire still burns within me.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on his interest in Chris Quinn's boat
quotes.excerpt: I saw Chris Quinn has a nice boat. I'm make him take me on his center console.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: How long until the boat? When are we getting into Biscayne Bay? Is that going to be soon?

text_blocks.speaker: Klay Thompson
text_blocks.text: It's going to be soon, hopefully. I don't want to get a new rig because it's a lot of work, but I saw Chris Quinn has a nice boat. I'm going to make him take me on his center console, man. Any fish is hard off that thing, so I want to see him in action. I want to see Captain Quinn out there.
